content_html:
Ship code, feed your buddy.

A pixel pet for Claude Code. It hatches in the footer next to your status line, eats what your work drops, levels up, earns rare trophies, does tricks and tells facts while Claude thinks, naps when you are away and plays with you on clicks. Every buddy you hatch stays in your nest, and nothing leaves your machine.

Install

  1. Open Claude Code 2.1.318 or later in a terminal. Older one? Run claude update

  2. Paste this at the prompt:

    /plugin install pixel-buddy --marketplace SimakovIgor/pixel-buddy

  3. Answer y and pick the user scope, so it hatches in every session

The egg hatches in the footer right away. In the desktop app: + next to the prompt box, Plugins, Add marketplace SimakovIgor/pixel-buddy, Add plugin. Update and removal are in the plugin's README.

If your buddy made you smile, a ⭐ helps other people find it

A quick look

Click it to pet it, double click for its own move, click an empty spot to throw a ball:

A right click opens the menu with a summary line. card shows its card in a frame above the prompt:

Rare moments of your work earn trophies: a commit deep in the night, a snack every day for a week, a legendary egg. Six are secret. Each one brings a gold cup and fireworks, and share copies a card to show it off in any chat:

Your trophy case opens from the menu, a pixel badge for each trophy:

Eight species, and each one comes and goes in its own way:

Feeding, moods, the nest, trophies, clicks, commands, what the buddy runs and sends, and troubleshooting are in the plugin's README.

In this repository

  • pixel-buddy/: the plugin, the folder people install
  • tests/: its tests, kept outside the plugin. Run them with sh tests/run.sh
  • .claude-plugin/marketplace.json: the marketplace simakovigor that lists the plugin

License

MIT
